sources.scope: AdManager.setServer configures a distributor network server. Its example uses g1.v.fwmrm.net/ad/g/1. getEventCallbackUrls exposes FreeWheel event callbacks.

generateTypeBRequestUrl preserves the configured fwmrm.net network host. EventCallback.parse receives the server URL; EventCallback.getUrl writes cn and et independently of that network hostname. No callback event enum is asserted.
First-party gallery explicitly configures demo.v.fwmrm.net, network 96749, gallery profile, video asset and site section.
Derived from the published gallery settings using the public SDK request layout. Response emits seven exact /ad/l/1 templates with cn, et and nonempty s. No callback is requested.

Exact SDK version linked by the current official gallery. Its configurable network-host request construction and EventCallback.getUrl cn/et behavior confirm the same explicit callback profile as SDK 6.55.0.

scope_reasoning: The SDK callback constructor works from the server-supplied callback URL for each configured MRM network; it does not hardcode the demo hostname. The API example and gallery establish the v.fwmrm.net network-host family. This profile narrows that family to the exact demonstrated /ad/l/1 route and explicit cn/et query profile.
implemented_advisories: Recommended nonempty cn and et in the explicit SDK callback profile
Recommended nonempty opaque s as emitted by the independent gallery producer
explicit_limits: No mandatory-field or server rejection claim
No closed cn or et vocabulary
No signature/identifier type, encoding or numeric timestamp grammar
The s-only callback representation remains outside this profile
No ad/g/ request contracts copied into the callback pack
